thread:
morgan: Quick checkstaging console shows 0 kvcache for fncall schema_reject fallbacks. Is that expected?

lina: Yepwe only emit kvcache metrics on successful fncall path so fallbacks don't emit.

samir: That avoided billing double-count originally. Ops/PM want rollout visibility though.

olivia: Suggestion: always emit kvcache.* with labels fallback=true and fallback_reason="schema_reject" and sampled="1pct" for high traffic. Billing ETL drops fallback=true.

morgan: OK. Console should have an "include fallbacks" toggle so dashboards don't explode by default.

lina: I'll add a saved view + short doc about sampling.

samir: Add an alert on derived fallback_rate >5% over 10m with min 1k calls.

infra-bot: deploy queued: metrics/fallback-labels -> infra/staging (owner: olivia)

olivia: I'll post the feature flag name and example metric lines after staging deploy.

morgan: Thanks all  run 48h canary then reconvene.
